title: Open WebUI Milvus multitenancy -- T1190 unescaped collection name interpolated into a Milvus expression
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-54019 (GHSA-p5cp-r7rg-qpxc,
CVSS 6.5 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI prior to 0.9.6.

Open WebUI added collection-level ACL checks for its vector-store
backend, but the patch is bypassable when Milvus multitenancy mode is
enabled: the ACL layer allows unknown, non-knowledge-base collection
names to pass through as legacy/ephemeral collections. In Milvus
multitenancy mode, that user-controlled collection name becomes a
`resource_id` value that is interpolated DIRECTLY into a Milvus
query expression -- without escaping. This is explicitly an
INCOMPLETE FIX for an earlier bug (CVE-2026-44560): the prior patch
closed one path but left this multitenancy-specific injection point
open.

Detection logic flags a knowledge/collection-referencing request whose
collection-name parameter contains Milvus expression-language
metacharacters (quotes, boolean operators like `and`/`or` adjacent to
comparison syntax, or expression-breaking punctuation) rather than an
ordinary alphanumeric collection identifier -- the specific injection
surface this advisory describes.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the prior CVE-2026-44560 this is an incomplete fix
for), fixed in 0.9.6.
